patch_resolves_note: The staged patch.diff is the unrelated gnutls benchmark overflow merge and does not touch the IDNA/punycode path. The authoritative fixed-side evidence comes from the real `n132/arvo:13356-fix` image, whose libidn2 `_idn2_punycode_decode` adds `if (input_length)` before the delimiter read.

root_cause_criterion.description: Immediately before evaluating `delim(input[b])`, `_idn2_punycode_decode` must establish that `input_length > 0`. On the witnessed empty-ACE path the vulnerable code reaches the delimiter read with `input_length == 0` and no guard.
root_cause_criterion.verification_note: The vulnerable original case records `puny_guard.input_length == 0` and still executes `puny_delim_read`. The fixed original reaches the same guard point with `input_length == 0` but skips the protected read, and the closest source-grounded perturbation `58 6e 2d 2d 61 00` (`Xn--a\0`) provides a genuine fixed witness with `input_length == 1` and `puny_delim_read` executed.

nodes.description: At the delimiter read `delim(input[b])`, the vulnerable witness reads one byte (`b + 1 == 1`) from an input buffer whose initialized prefix is 0, so the read consumes the unwritten first byte of the zero-length ACE allocation.
nodes.evidence: The vulnerable original trace records `puny_delim_read.read_end == 1` and `puny_delim_read.input_initialized_prefix_len == 0`.

edges.description: The `input_length` argument observed at `_idn2_punycode_decode` entry propagates unchanged to the later missing-guard check at the delimiter setup block.
edges.evidence: The vulnerable original trace records `ace_ready.ace_len == puny_guard.input_length == 0`, and the non-empty perturbation records the same equality at 1.

edges.description: The same `input` pointer passed at `_idn2_punycode_decode` entry is the buffer later dereferenced by `delim(input[b])`.
edges.evidence: The vulnerable original trace records `ace_ready.ace_ptr == puny_delim_read.input_ptr`, both pointing at the same zero-length ACE buffer.
